svg.title: Home network switch ports and VLANs
svg.desc: The Firewalla router connects to switch 192.168.1.2 port 5. Port 4 of that switch connects to port 8 of switch 192.168.1.4 at 2.5G. Port 9 of that switch connects to port 8 of switch 192.168.1.5 at 10G. All three inter-switch links carry VLANs 1, 10, 50, 100, 101 and 103.
